**Drug Details for NDC: 65012-100-01**

**Basic Information:**
- Brand Name: Sierra Soft Alcohol Hand Sanitizer
- Generic Name: ETHYL ALCOHOL
- Manufacturer: CWGC LA Inc.
- Route: TOPICAL
- Dosage Form: Not specified
- Active Substance: ALCOHOL
- Last Updated: 20250417

**Indications and Usage:**
1. Uses For sanitizing to reduce bacteria on the skin.

**Purpose/Uses:**
1. Purpose Antibacterial

**Warnings:**
1. Warnings For external use only Flammable: Keep away from fire or flame When using this product avoid contact with eyes. In case of eye contact, flush with water Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.

**Dosage and Administration:**
1. Directions • Apply one shot of foaming sanitizer to dry hands • Rub into skin • No rinsing required

**Additional Information:**
- Spl Product Data Elements: Sierra Soft Alcohol Hand Sanitizer ETHYL ALCOHOL WATER ISOPROPYL ALCOHOL PROPYLENE GLYCOL ALCOHOL ALCOHOL
- Spl Unclassified Section: Drug Facts
- Active Ingredient: Active ingredient Ethyl Alcohol 70% Purpose Antibacterial
- When Using: When using this product avoid contact with eyes. In case of eye contact, flush with water
- Keep Out Of Reach Of Children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
- Inactive Ingredient: Inactive ingredients Water, Isopropyl Alcohol, Propylene Glycol, PEG-12 Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Bis-PEG-12 Dimethicone
